participant_a_prompt_text: Tell your partner about a time when you avoided conflict or a difficult conversation, even though it might have been better to address the issue directly. What were you hoping to achieve by avoiding the conflict, and how did it ultimately turn out?
participant_b_prompt_text: Your partner will share a story about avoiding conflict. Discuss with them whether they think avoiding the conflict was the right decision, and what they might do differently in a similar situation in the future.
